# Scaffold
Your Ultimate Launch OS.

## Overview
Stop rebuilding from scratch. Scaffold is a modern, modular Next.js application template with 120+ pre-built components to ship your ideas faster.

## Features
- Over 120+ pre-built template blocks.
- Modular Monolith architecture.
- Powered by Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS.
- Secure Authentication via Supabase.
- Background Jobs orchestrated by Inngest.
- High-performance caching & rate-limiting with Upstash Redis.
